vc_shape.pre_pure: avl_node_pre <> NULL, avl_search_cursor_valid g avl_node_pre data_pre, avl_gvalid g, and input integer bounds

witnesses.witness_instantiation: No EX is introduced; the current cursor and its model-projected children are used directly.
witnesses.space_plan: Unfold the non-null subtree slice, use reflexive offspring to isolate the current node, partition the remaining descendant list into left and right offspring lists, rewrite iter_sepcon by the resulting permutation, and unfold avl_graph_node_store for the four fields.
witnesses.pure_plan: Non-null cursor validity selects its second disjunct and supplies avl_vvalid g avl_node_pre. The isolated avl_graph_node_store supplies key and height bounds; cursor validity and avl_gvalid are direct hypotheses.
witnesses.refinement_plan: No safeExec state occurs; this is graph-slice decomposition.

candidate_helper_declarations.statement_shape: for non-null valid p in a valid AVL graph, avl_subtree_store_at g p entails avl_graph_node_store g p separated from the left and right child subtree stores

premises.premise: avl_gvalid g /\ avl_vvalid g p /\ p <> NULL
premises.discharged_by: avl_gvalid and non-nullness are direct; avl_vvalid follows from the non-null branch of avl_search_cursor_valid
premises.arithmetic: none beyond the bounds already stored in avl_graph_node_store

premise_discharge: cursor validity plus p <> NULL yields p validity
the subtree store owns the current node because offspring is reflexive
valid-tree child uniqueness separates the left and right descendant slices
witnesses.recommended_next_phase: vc-proving-preparing after annotation blockers are repaired
witnesses.grouping_reason: Uses the same subtree decomposition family later needed to reconstruct recursive returns and bridge the root-level spec.

vc_shape.pre_spatial: current-node raw fields plus left and right avl_subtree_store_at slices
vc_shape.pre_pure: current cursor validity/validity, avl_gvalid, and avl_key_of current < data_pre

witnesses.witness_instantiation: The next cursor is avl_ptr_of (avl_right g current).
witnesses.space_plan: All spatial resources frame unchanged; they do not recover the missing pure non-null-address invariant after the parent slice has been decomposed.
witnesses.pure_plan: BST ordering would confine a matching key to the right subtree, but the current specification permits avl_right g current = Some NULL. Then avl_ptr_of is NULL and the requested cursor predicate demands global key absence, although the valid NULL-address child may itself carry data_pre.
witnesses.refinement_plan: The abstract cursor transition is not valid under the current model because Some NULL and None collapse to the same concrete cursor.
witnesses.failure_signal: avl_gvalid has no premise forall x, avl_vvalid g x -> x <> NULL; no helper with premises derivable from this VC can exclude a valid child at address NULL.
witnesses.grouping_reason: Right-descent confinement is semantically blocked by the missing model/address invariant.

vc_shape.pre_spatial: current-node raw fields plus left and right avl_subtree_store_at slices
vc_shape.pre_pure: current cursor validity/validity, avl_gvalid, data_pre <= current key, and inequality

witnesses.witness_instantiation: The next cursor is avl_ptr_of (avl_left g current).
witnesses.space_plan: All resources frame unchanged, but the decomposed left slice at concrete NULL is emp and contains no fact excluding Some NULL.
witnesses.pure_plan: The two comparisons imply data_pre < current key, so BST ordering would select the left subtree only after proving the selected graph child is either None or Some non-NULL. That fact is absent.
witnesses.refinement_plan: The abstract cursor transition is invalid for the same Some NULL/None aliasing as the right branch.
witnesses.failure_signal: A valid left child at address NULL is allowed by avl_gvalid, making the target cursor predicate's global-absence branch false when that child has the searched key.
witnesses.grouping_reason: Left-descent confinement has the symmetric model/address defect.

vc_shape.pre_spatial: current-node raw fields and both child subtree stores
vc_shape.pre_pure: data_pre equals current key, current node is non-null and valid, avl_gvalid, and key/height bounds

witnesses.witness_instantiation: The successful return pointer is the current node.
witnesses.space_plan: The search-result pure fact follows directly, but reverse folding of the two child slices and raw fields into the parent slice requires every valid child address to be non-NULL.
witnesses.pure_plan: Use current non-nullness, current validity, and the key equality for the success disjunct of avl_search_result.
witnesses.refinement_plan: No safeExec state occurs; the blocker is the representation fold.
premise_discharge: the success-result conjuncts are direct hypotheses
witnesses.failure_signal: If a graph child is Some NULL, its avl_subtree_store_at slice is emp in the antecedent, while the parent slice includes that valid vertex and therefore requires avl_graph_node_store g NULL, whose pure NULL <> NULL conjunct is impossible.
witnesses.grouping_reason: Successful-return folding is blocked by the same missing non-null-address invariant.

vc_shape.pre_spatial: returned right-child subtree, current-node raw fields, and framed left-child subtree
vc_shape.pre_pure: recursive avl_search_result, child cursor validity, avl_gvalid, destination_node = 0, and current pointer non-null; one disjunct additionally has key/height bounds
vc_shape.pre_exists: retval is universally bound from the recursive result
vc_shape.post_pure: the recursive search result and avl_gvalid

witnesses.witness_instantiation: Reuse retval from the recursive call.
witnesses.space_plan: Reorder the framed resources and fold them into the parent subtree only after recovering the parent avl_graph_node_store pure conjuncts.
witnesses.pure_plan: Search result and graph validity are direct, but neither disjunct supplies avl_vvalid g current. The basic disjunct also omits the parent key/height bounds.
witnesses.refinement_plan: The recursive result is already at the same graph state; the defect is lost frame metadata, not state refinement.
witnesses.failure_signal: A nonzero current address outside avl_nodes g with model children None can satisfy the raw field resources and NULL child stores, but avl_subtree_store_at g current reduces to emp; a nonempty raw-field heap cannot entail emp. Parent validity cannot be derived from the listed hypotheses.
witnesses.grouping_reason: Right-recursive return loses parent representation facts at the branch assertion/call boundary.

vc_shape.pre_spatial: returned left-child subtree, current-node raw fields, and framed right-child subtree
vc_shape.pre_pure: recursive avl_search_result, child cursor validity, avl_gvalid, destination_node = 0, and current pointer non-null; one disjunct additionally has key/height bounds
vc_shape.pre_exists: retval is universally bound from the recursive result
vc_shape.post_pure: the recursive search result and avl_gvalid

witnesses.witness_instantiation: Reuse retval from the recursive call.
witnesses.space_plan: Symmetric to the right-recursive return; folding needs the omitted parent node metadata.
witnesses.pure_plan: Search result and graph validity are direct, but parent validity is absent in both alternatives and key/height bounds are absent in the basic alternative.
witnesses.refinement_plan: No graph update occurs; the failure is an insufficient branch assertion.
witnesses.failure_signal: The same invalid-parent countermodel as return_wit_2 satisfies the antecedent but cannot discard four raw field cells to establish an empty parent slice.
witnesses.grouping_reason: Left-recursive return has the symmetric lost-metadata defect.

premise_discharge: ret = NULL is reflexive after rewriting PreH1
global key absence is contained in PreH4

Give that slice to the low-level pre and construct the residual wand; when the wand receives the unchanged low-level slice and result, reattach the pure graph validity to rebuild avl_rep.
witnesses.pure_plan: For Some root, gvalid root validity and root reachability establish cursor confinement of every matching node. For None, rooted-tree validity implies no valid vertices, giving global key absence. Bounds and graph validity come directly from the high-level pre/avl_rep.
witnesses.refinement_plan: This is high/low spec refinement with identical abstract graph state, not an algorithm mirror.

blockers.message: Current model permits valid vertices at NULL, so avl_ptr_of cannot distinguish None from Some NULL during cursor descent and subtree reassembly.
Recursive branch assertions do not preserve parent avl_vvalid and required key/height range facts, so return_wit_2 and return_wit_3 cannot fold the parent subtree.
Add a derivable non-null-address invariant for all valid AVL vertices to the search cursor/spec context (or to avl_gvalid), so Some NULL is excluded before mapping option children through avl_ptr_of.
